name: AddCommentToCase
label: Add a Comment to a Case
description: Adds a comment to an existing Case in Salesforce.

fields.name: Credential
fields.label: Credential to Connect With
fields.description: The Salesforce connection credential to use for authentication.

fields.name: Resource
fields.label: Resource
fields.description: The Salesforce object to operate on. Must be 'Case'.

fields.name: Operation
fields.label: Operation
fields.description: The operation to perform. Must be 'Add a comment to a case'.

fields.name: CaseId
fields.label: Case ID
fields.description: The Salesforce ID of the Case to add a comment to.

fields.name: CommentBody
fields.label: Comment Body
fields.description: The text of the comment to add.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The raw response from Salesforce after adding the comment.
